title: WR-90 filled with a lossy dielectric (εr = 2.2, tan δ = 0.02), 30 mm, ports in the lossy medium
source: A uniform line with its ports in it: S11 = 0, S21 = e^{−γL}, γ = √((π/a)² − k0² εr(1 − j tan δ)) with Re γ ≥ 0 (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.3; time dependence e^{jωt}), evaluated separately from EMCraft's code

quantities.reason: second-order elements of 3 mm; the attenuation is exact in the element mass matrix, the remaining error is the discretisation's (about 1e-3 dB here)
the phase error of second-order elements of 3 mm over 30 mm (about 1.3 guide wavelengths), as for the lossless dielectric step
the port condition in the lossy medium is exact for its modes: what reflects is discretisation error only (about 1e-4)
the phase error above: measured 3.0e-3, at 12 GHz (about ten elements per guide wavelength in the filling)
